title: Studio Access polish: jargon duplicate-draft refusal, OWD banner outliving revert, stale set label in the rail, clipped field counter, no re-grant for a dismissed suggestion
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named.
Batch-of: studio-qa-2026-10-27 — 39 cards from one Studio QA run (coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`; tested at `3fcafcd3`; `origin/main` was `43731031` at filing, so the implementer re-checks the landing site on current main). The run record is the `qa-run` issue filed with this batch.

## Symptom

Five small Access-pillar defects measured in one pass.

## Reproduction

1. Create a set whose draft already exists → message "this save asserted that no draft row exists (the first-write pin, If-None-Match: *…)".
2. OWD Memo → Controlled by parent → Save refused → revert → "No changes" but the refusal bullet stays.
3. More › Edit name/label append " v2" → autosaved; rail keeps the old label until publish/reload.
4. 1440×900: "14 / 14" field counter clipped; at 900px the field-name column is not sticky.
5. Dismiss or revoke a suggested binding → no re-grant affordance (`GET /api/v1/security/suggested-bindings?packageId=…` status dismissed).

## Expected

Author-facing refusal text; banner cleared on revert; rail label live; counter visible and sticky name column; re-grant control for dismissed suggestions.

## Suspected landing site (the implementer verifies)

AccessPillar / `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` / suggestions panel under `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/`.

## Filing facts

- reach: Studio UI, measured by the Access QA card.
- Business reason: Each is small; together they make the Access pillar feel unreliable.
- Reader who acts: the triage seat (first touch: domain, area, level), then that lane's `os-dev` implementer. QA suggestion only: `domain:ui`, `area:access`, p3.
- Dedupe: semantic search `permission set duplicate draft refusal jargon If-None-Match OWD refusal banner rail label` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 61 hits, none about these five (nearest open #26170 i18n of hook refusals — different).
- QA id: A9
